summary: Independent verification of ODS-001 Operational Data Spine + AI Provider Gateway. Created /app/backend/tests/test_ods_001_e2e_review.py (9 pytest tests) covering all 12 review checkpoints. minor.issue: 1448 routes (get+post+put+delete+patch) vs review spec of 1455. Off by 7. Non-blocking but reviewer should reconcile whether spec expectation counts differently (e.g., include options/head, or a truly missed 7 routes).

Consider surfacing /api/openapi.json in preview ingress OR document the difference; currently 404 externally, 200 on localhost:8001.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/ods/projects/{project_id}/config REQUIRES project_id in request body (validated by Pydantic ProjectOperationalConfigPayload) AND checks payload.project_id == path project_id. Review spec examples imply body-only body, but working shape is {project_id, tenant_id, cost_codes[]}. Consider auto-injecting path param if missing to reduce caller friction.
AI Gateway env_snapshot() correctly boolean-flattens providers_with_keys — zero risk of key leakage in /api/ods/meta payload. Good.
test_credentials: No auth required for /api/dr-v2/* and /api/ods/* in preview (as documented). /api/daily-reports V1 remains 401-gated (pre-existing, not a drift).
